channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about DeMarcus Cousins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about DeMarcus Cousins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I would say the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams. I've probably in my life ever had to tag the roller. During defense, you're on the other side and you come over to tag the roller to hold him up so he doesn't DeAndre Jordan, alley-oop dunk, Blake Griffin, alley-oop dunk like that, Mitchell Robinson, alley-oop dunk. You try to slow down the roller so it makes it easier to deal with the pick and roll, the player, two offensive players and the two defensive players. It makes it easier and gives them more time to figure out the situation with the PNR.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Durant on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Except … upon more reflection, Durant realized he actually picked the wrong team.

“Obviously, the best team I played on was the Warriors. I want to say the 2019 team was crazy, but we got hurt. With Cousins at the five, that’s probably the best team I’ve been a part of on paper.”

Kevin Durant on DeMarcus Cousins, Aug 27, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, DeMarcus Cousins, Austin Reaves, Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Suns coach Suns coach Jordan Ott on team owner Mat Ishbia shooting down former NBA player DeMarcus Cousins suggesting Lakers trading Austin Reaves for Dillon Brooks:

“I have zero social media impact. We love Dillon. We had a big game last night. A big basketball game that we played. Loved that one. We’ve got another challenge tonight.”

Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, DeMarcus Cousins, Austin Reaves, Mat Ishbia, Jan 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Adelman on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
David Adelman:

“You can play through him. I said this the other day — and I really meant it — I thought people forget how good DeMarcus Cousins was for us that second half of that season. Jonas is a guy you can post up against smaller lineups. He’s a proficient player down there, very good dribble handoff player, you can play him off the elbows. He’s a guy those guards can play through. And when Jok doesn’t play, you have a legitimate starting center that we just happen to be lucky enough to have as our backup. So we’re super blessed to get him. Cannot wait for him to get to the United States — get to Denver. We’re so excited to have him.”

David Adelman on DeMarcus Cousins, Jul 16, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: David Adelman on DeMarcus Cousins, Nikola Jokic, Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Adelman on Jonas Valanciunas:

“Point center. You can play combo guards, you don't need a lead PG, you can play 5-out offense, off the elbow, post him up. He's such a skilled player... 1st time we have our backup with a similar skillset to Nikola Jokic beside DeMarcus Cousins.”

David Adelman on DeMarcus Cousins, Nikola Jokic, Jonas Valanciunas, Jul 11, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
“I was confused a lot. I was sliding back into the four during some possessions [and I heard], ‘AD, run corner!’ I forgot. So, it was good. Still figuring things out. Talking with the coaches and Jaxson and C-Wood about some things that I did with DeMarcus [Cousins] and Julius [Randle] back in New Orleans. So, it’s been good.”

Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes, Oct 6, 2023. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Bob Myers on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Bob Myers:

“DeMarcus Cousins called me a month ago and he said, ‘Why am I not in the NBA?’”

Bob Myers on DeMarcus Cousins, Nov 26, 2022. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Steve Kerr congratulated Nikola Jokic and the Nuggets on a terrific season.

“Ialso want to mention how happy I am for DeMarcus Cousins. Obviously, I wanted to win, but that guy put his heart on the line for us several years ago, and he's been through hell.”

Nikola Jokic on DeMarcus Cousins, Apr 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Will Barton
item.description:
Nuggets coach Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins & Will Barton having an argument:

“If we're fragmented, if we're breaking off into groups or individuals, then we have zero chance of winning a game in this series.”

Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Will Barton, Apr 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
“Like here’s DeMarcus, four-time All-Star, out of the league. Shouldn’t be the case, and he’s here with us, he’s found a home.“I love him, and I think you can see all the teammates, when he has a play like that, whether it’s blocking a shot, rolling and dunking, hitting a three, you can feel the energy.”

Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Feb 15, 2022. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Outside of Cousins, no one’s been happier to see his success than Malone.

“You can see all the guys on our bench, even on the court and on the bench, how much they’re rooting for DeMarcus, which is really neat for me, just from a personal level, from a family atmosphere type of a thing,”

Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Feb 15, 2022. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone:

“I fully expect DeMarcus Cousins to be back with us at some point...it is my hope that DeMarcus will be back with us in the near future.”

Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Feb 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone today on @AltitudeSR:

“If (DeMarcus Cousins) becomes a member of this Nugget team at some point, obviously you’d be adding a terrific player. I think his short stint in Milwaukee is proof of that. He went to the defending world champions and played lights out.”

Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Jan 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Jon Horst on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Horst told ESPN on Wednesday night.

“At the end of the day, we made a strategic decision to have an open roster spot, but there's nothing that would prevent us from partnering with DeMarcus again down the road. He was so good for us, and hopefully we helped him too.”

Jon Horst on DeMarcus Cousins, Jan 6, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jon Horst on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
“We wouldn't have been able to get through this difficult stretch of the season as successfully as we did without DeMarcus,”

Jon Horst on DeMarcus Cousins, Jan 6, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on DeMarcus Cousins:

“He's helped us already this year...once he learns the plays and the sets and what we're trying to do defensively... he definitely can (help in playoffs)”

Tyronn Lue on DeMarcus Cousins, Apr 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Paul George on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Paul George on DeMarcus Cousins:

“We're getting flashes of vintage Boogie...what will be most impressive about his game is that he automatically draws double teams. He's instant offense for us, dump the ball down there for him and he's a playmaker.”

Paul George on DeMarcus Cousins, Apr 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Paul George on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Paul George on DeMarcus Cousins:

“He's an All-Star. Still one of the most skilled bigs in this league... I thought you saw a little bit of everything from him tonight. He showed he has a lot left to give. I am looking forward to him getting into the groove.”

Paul George on DeMarcus Cousins, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: John Wall on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
John Wall on the #Rockets letting DeMarcus Cousins go:

“It’s tough. Someone I call my brother. The decision that was made, that’s out of my hands. I think he did a hell of a job coming back from an injury, hopefully he’ll get another job soon.”

John Wall on DeMarcus Cousins, Feb 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @KellyIkoNBA.

item.title: Rudy Gay on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, David Nwaba
item.description:
Rudy Gay on helping Wall, Cousins & Nwaba overcome Achilles injuries:

“I just want people to do well and have control of their careers. (It's) an injury where people have written you off and told you you can’t come back or it’s career-ending. But if I can do it, they can do it.”

Rudy Gay on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, David Nwaba, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Stephen Silas:

“During the film, on the court when we were going over the defensive stuff. The whole spirit of the group was really really good, and [DeMarcus Cousins and John Wall] contributed to that for sure.”

Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, Dec 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, Christian Wood
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Stephen Silas on Cousins and Wood as floor spacers:

“You can't play back on those guys as a defensive Center. You have to play up on those guys. That gives us wider lanes, more ability to get to our drive-and-kick game, and more ability to cut into the paint.”

Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, Christian Wood, Dec 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Ben McLemore on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Ben McLemore on DeMarcus Cousins:

“From what I'm seeing now, he's in great shape... He looks like the old DeMarcus I know.”

Ben McLemore on DeMarcus Cousins, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Ben McLemore on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
David Hardisty:Ben McLemore on Demarcus Cousins:

“That's my guy. He's always been a big brother to me. Guys forget that DeMarcus has been a beast and still is a beast. From what I'm seeing in him now, he's in great shape. He looks like the old DeMarcus I know.”

Ben McLemore on DeMarcus Cousins, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Grant Napear on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
“I know a lot of people are making it about DeMarcus because of the friction we had. And I mean this, I don’t have anything against DeMarcus. He’s got a lot of good qualities. He’s also got some bad qualities,again, but he’s got a pretty good heart,”

Grant Napear on DeMarcus Cousins, Oct 18, 2020. Source: Fox40.com.

item.title: Rodney Hood on Kevin Durant, DeMarcus Cousins, Wesley Matthews
item.description:
“I reach out to Kevin Durant or Wesley Matthews, DeMarcus Cousins ... the guys who have been through it, and I just get confident more and more every day.”

Rodney Hood on Kevin Durant, DeMarcus Cousins, Wesley Matthews, Jun 16, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: George Karl on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
“I commented on not being smart enough to say DeMarcus wasn’t tradeable. I think that was the biggest mistake.”

George Karl on DeMarcus Cousins, Jun 9, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: George Karl on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
The Kings lacked talent and the idea was to potentially trade Cousins in a deal for multiple players that might help the team win.

“I didn’t want to trade Cousins, unless it made our basketball team better,”

George Karl on DeMarcus Cousins, May 30, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Frank Vogel on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Frank Vogel on DeMarcus Cousins:

“He’s allowed to still be with our team and rehab. He’s become part of our family.”

Frank Vogel on DeMarcus Cousins, Feb 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Alex Caruso on DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Alex Caruso on Cousins:

“DeMarcus has been here rehabbing and been a great member of this team behind the scenes that nobody gets to see because the only thing he can do is be a good teammate and travel,and show up to every game and have a good attitude. And he’s done that.”

Alex Caruso on DeMarcus Cousins, Feb 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.
